title: mini-bisect photometry station with resumable shadow synchronizer and autorevert
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added a mini-bisect station for cohort-level regression localization; introduced traffic photometry metrics and a resumable shadow synchronizer with policy-driven autorevert. Backward-compatible CLI and rollout API additions. Documented usage and added integration tests.
description:
Motivation: we see intermittent regressions in staged promotes where noisy cohorts mask root causes. This PR adds a lightweight "mini-bisect" orchestration helper (the "photometry station") that can automatically bisect a failing cohort slice using shadowed traffic and traffic photometry signals, then optionally trigger a policy-driven autorevert with audit-grade snapshots. The implementation focuses on resumable work: long-running bisect jobs survive controller restarts and can be resumed or manually inspected via rwdctl.

What this PR does (single-line summary): introduce photometry-driven mini-bisect workflow, resumable shadow synchronizer state machine, CLI bindings, telemetry, docs, and tests.

Details: This change includes three cooperating pieces: 1) photometry collector: lightweight runtime hook that computes cohort-level distribution shifts (response-time histogram drift, token-length changes, error-rate heatmap) and exposes these as rollout gates; 2) mini-bisect station: an orchestration component that will split a suspect cohort into two halves, route shadowed traffic through each variant, compare photometry deltas, and iterate until the smallest failing slice is found; 3) resumable shadow synchronizer & autorevert: state machine that manages shadow routing (pause/resume/drain), captures a snapshot of model revision + KV cache state, and if configured triggers an autorevert that records an undo snapshot and annotates the audit log.

Usage: rwdctl rollout bisect --rollout-id <id> --metric photometry.latency_hist --threshold 0.12  # starts a bisect job using latency photometry. Jobs appear under /rollouts/<id>/bisect/<job-id>. The controller UI shows live photometry graphs. Autorevert is opt-in via rollout.policy.autorevert=true.

Checklist:
- [x] controller: coordinator and state machine with durable jobs
- [x] runtime: photometry hooks & lightweight instrumentation
- [x] CLI: rwdctl bisect commands (start/status/abort/resume)
- [x] API: rollout endpoints for bisect jobs and snapshots
- [x] integration tests: synthetic shadow replay harness reproducing a regression and exercising autorevert
- [x] docs: rollout runbook and security note for snapshot artifacts

Backward compatibility: All API additions are additive. Existing rollout flows unchanged unless the new autorevert flag is enabled. Snapshot artifacts are stored in customer-scoped buckets and encrypted with existing KMS integrations.

Limitations & future work: current bisect splits are simple binary partitions (by cohort key hash). Future iterations will support multi-armed bisection and traffic stratification. We also plan a UI to visualize the bisect decision tree.

Related work: design doc: internal://design/rollouts/photometry-bisect (ENG-2145), incident notes: SUP-4821.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the durable job encoding (rollout/bisect/job.pb) and the snapshot lifecycle to ensure there are no retention leaks. I left obvious TODOs for extended instrumentation that are safe to follow up on.

review_comments:
Diego Alvarez (2025-11-04): Can you clarify how we avoid double-counting when a bisect job runs while autoscaling reshuffles session affinity?
— Maya: added a note in state_machine.go and added a session-lease check to the coordinator to fence concurrent reallocations.

Priya Nair (2025-11-05): The snapshot retention logic needs an explicit TTL policy and a purge job. Otherwise customers with frequent bisects may accumulate artifacts.
— Maya: added a snapshot_pruner cron and documented retention defaults (30 days) and customer override via rollout.policy.snapshot_ttl_days.

Liam O'Connor (2025-11-06): linter failure on CLI flag names; please follow kebab-case convention for flags.
— Maya: fixed flag names and updated tests. CI green on rerun.

Diego Alvarez (2025-11-07): Approving but request we add an observability dashboard tile for photometry histograms in a follow-up.
— Maya: noted in ENG-2201 and added a TODO in docs. Approved.

notes_audit: Snapshot artifacts recorded with UUIDs and linked to rollout audit. Autoreverts create an undo snapshot and an audit entry. Operators must have rollback permission to trigger autorevert. See docs/rollouts/photometry-bisect.md for audit fields.
testing_summary: Integration harness simulates a regression by flipping a synthetic feature flag in a subset of cohorts. The bisect job successfully isolates the failing cohort slice in under 6 bisect iterations in the synthetics. Autorevert flow verified end-to-end; metrics are emitted to rollout.telemetry.photometry.* and alerts fire on threshold violations.
